intent: Pre-release from pinned beta branch after Python 3.13/3.14, translations, frontend, Hassfest, and HACS checks; never update main or stable latest
note: Per-device quiet occupancy/sleep behavior, strict occupied/absent/always control, capability-specific soft bounds and availability-first runtime gating
changes: Expose Quiet when in room and Quiet when sleeping switches on each managed physical-device controller when its native fan is adjustable
Use the configured native low/quiet fan mode or quiet percentage, clamped to the same controller's fan bounds, without powering a device merely for quiet mode
Replace managed-device presence control with per-device Always, Room occupied, or Room absent policy; unknown evidence never authorizes a conditional policy
Expose temperature, humidity and percentage-fan min/max limits only when supported by that physical device, inside its native capabilities
Clamp all Manager-issued targets, PID trims, humidity commands and fan percentages to those per-device limits while the Manager owns the control path
Wait for every selected native endpoint of the managed physical device to become available before capability, occupancy, target, measurement or PID calculations
Preserve legacy room/home policy semantics for old drivers while migrating managed-controller legacy values conservatively to Room occupied
Retain rooms-first setup, Home/room/controller hierarchy, command ownership, dwell/interlock protections and stable v0.5.1
